title: SAIGON SIGHTSEEING AND CRAFT BEER TOUR
summary: Experience Saigon like a local with Vietlook Travel , combining sightseeing, street food, and craft beer in a fun and authentic way.
html:
Experience Saigon like a local with Vietlook Travel, combining sightseeing, street food, and craft beer in a fun and authentic way.

Highlights / Itinerary

  • Bún Bò Huế – Central Vietnamese Beef Noodle Soup: Taste the famous spicy beef noodle soup from Hue, made with tender beef, round rice vermicelli, special broth cooked for hours, and a variety of fresh herbs.

  • Nguyen Thien Thuat Apartment: Step into one of the oldest apartments in Saigon (built in 1968) to experience the authentic daily life of locals.

  • District 10 Flower Market: Try your hand at making a lotus flower (Vietnam’s national flower) and learn about local traditions of buying and using flowers.

  • Cambodia Market – Famous Street Food Area: Walk through this lively food area, enjoy authentic street food, and see how locals hang out.

  • Bia Sệt – Frozen Beer: Try the local specialty beer in a unique frozen style.

  • Craft Beer: Enjoy craft beer in a pub with an authentic local atmosphere.
outline: Day 1: SAIGON SIGHTSEEING AND CRAFT BEER TOUR
